SELECT 
	CustomerCategory,
	CustomerAlias,
	Customer,
	NTN,
	SaleAmt=SUM(SaleAmt),
	TaxAmt = SUM(TaxAmt)
FROM
	(SELECT 
		CustomerCategory=SC.Name,
		CustomerAlias = A.AliasName,
		Customer = A.Name,
		NTN=S.NTNNo,
		SaleAmt=SUM(D.SalePrice * D.LooseQty),
		TaxAmt = SUM((((D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * D.LooseQty * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01) + ((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax)))
	FROM 
		SaleLedger P, 
		SaleDetail D, 
		Customer S, 
		CustomerCategory SC, 
		Accounts A, 
		Item I,
		SalesTaxSchedule ST
	WHERE 
		SC.CustCatCode IN (:ai_CustCatCode) AND
		SC.CustCatCode = S.CustCatCode AND
		S.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
		S.CustCode = P.CustCode AND
		P.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		P.Posted = 'Y' AND
		P.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
		D.ICode = I.ICode AND
		I.SalesTaxScheduleCode = ST.SalesTaxScheduleCode
	GROUP BY
		SC.Name,
		A.AliasName,
		A.Name,
		S.NTNNo
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		CustomerCategory=SC.Name,
		CustomerAlias = A.AliasName,
		Customer = A.Name,
		NTN=S.NTNNo,
		SaleAmt= - SUM(D.SRPrice * D.LooseQty),
		TaxAmt = - SUM(((D.SRPrice * D.LooseQty * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01) + ((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax)))
	FROM 
		SRLedger P, 
		SRDetail D, 
		Customer S, 
		CustomerCategory SC, 
		Accounts A, 
		Item I,
		SalesTaxSchedule ST
	WHERE 
		SC.CustCatCode IN (:ai_CustCatCode) AND
		SC.CustCatCode = S.CustCatCode AND
		S.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
		S.CustCode = P.CustCode AND
		P.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		P.Posted = 'Y' AND
		P.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND
		D.ICode = I.ICode AND
		I.SalesTaxScheduleCode = ST.SalesTaxScheduleCode
	GROUP BY
		SC.Name,
		A.AliasName,
		A.Name,
		S.NTNNo) T
GROUP BY
	CustomerCategory,
	CustomerAlias,
	Customer,
	NTN
